meta.title: Antmicro baseboard · no 3.3 V, flaky 5 V
meta.author: DEADBOARD
meta.description: An open-source carrier board for a compute module (392 parts), fed 12 V on VIN. The module will not start: 3.3 V is missing, and the customer says the 5 V rail "sometimes" drops out when the board is handled. Bench supply: 12 V on VIN (no voltage in the name VIN: 12 V assumed).
hints: With Solver: SPICE + PWR, measure 5V0_SYS and 3V3_SYS. Then follow 3.3 V back from its output to its input. Is the converter switching (scope, key O)?
A converter with input and enable present and no output is a dead part: replace it with the parts bin.
For the dropouts, press on the board (key B) near the 5 V input filter while watching the rail, then reflow what moves.
